image_description: A close-up portrait of a person wearing a short, layered wig with white and pink streaks. The subject is smiling and looking slightly downward. The wig features a distinct fringe and appears to be made of synthetic fibers. A pink ribbon or accessory is visible in the hair. The subject wears a beige ribbed top and a silver chain necklace. Hands are partially visible at the top, adjusting the wig.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight clumping and uniformity in the hair strands suggest AI generation or heavy filtering, lacking the fine chaotic variance of individual real hairs, but still coherent.
The silver chain necklace appears to merge slightly with the skin and clothing folds, lacking clear depth separation. The chin line also softens into the neck unusually.
The hands at the top are blurry and indistinct, blending into the background/hair, which is a common artifact in AI portraits where extremities are poorly defined.
